title: Filling gaps for the libre sensor
symptom: The user asks about handling gaps in Libre sensor data when using xDrip with Blucon or scanning. They describe scenarios where scans occur at irregular intervals (e.g., 2 minutes after a previous scan, 7 minutes after, or after a 60-minute disconnection) and question how to display data and avoid gaps or rejections due to xDrip's 5-minute data storage and 4-minute rejection rule.
evidence_quote: The trivial solution to these problems is calculating the per 5 minutes data and having xDrip reject points that are more than 4 minutes apart. Does anyone has a better solution?
